title: My first jump
done: Vroom, up the ramp, and fly! The truck jumped the gap.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table. The road starts here.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
Stand a ring of 4 squares where the ramp will rest.
Lean the kicker up onto the ring. Launch!
Lock the ramp: lean one more square from the side of the tower up under the middle of the ramp. Now it holds a truck.
Leave a gap, then lay a yellow square flat. The truck lands here!
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
